properties.description: Squash-merge a branch that carries an overlay into main, then pull main into the main checkout. PASS: the shared store now holds the branch's facts, the overlay is gone, and a second fold attempt changes nothing. A second branch deleted without merging leaves its facts readable as retired history and absent from the shared store.
properties.name: A branch's overlay folds into main after a squash-merge, exactly once, and a deleted unmerged branch's overlay is retired, not folded
